label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be _____ among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
verse: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
note: The chief priests quoted this to Herod when the wise men asked where the king would be born.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Make a joyful _____ unto the LORD, all ye lands.
verse: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
note: Make a joyful noise — note it says noise, not a perfect performance. Everyone qualifies.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than _____, they were stronger than lions.
verse: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
note: David's lament for Saul and Jonathan: swifter than eagles, stronger than lions, and not divided in death.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye are bought with a _____: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
verse: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
note: Paul's closing argument in a chapter on purity: your body has been purchased — treat it as the temple it is.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: No man that warreth _____ himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verse: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
note: No soldier on duty 'entangleth himself' with civilian affairs — he aims to please the one who enlisted him.
